channel.title: Hauntings
channel.description:
Hauntings is a documentary audio project by Madeleine Lebovic and Iván Ruiz-Knott.
We’re exploring stories about Christian Hell Houses (did they ever work?), the commercial side of haunted houses (who decides what’s trending in fear?), hearse conventions (where do hearses go when they’re decommissioned?), and other spooky, non-paranormal topics.
We’re currently in production and seeking distribution partners. If you’d like to chat, give us a scare or email us at madeleine@lebovic.com and ivan@ruiz-knott.com.

item.title: Hell House
item.description: In the 1990s and early 2000s, churches across the country put on Hell Houses—haunted houses designed to convert people to Christianity. A friend of ours was once tricked into attending one, and was left with so many questions. Decades later, we’re getting her some answers.
